title: Shinonome Ena — You Never Fail〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hmm... It still feels too rigid...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Flowers wafting in the breeze are supposed to look softer and more graceful.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means I should probably make it more abstract. So...
<Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... Rin, Len, you two decided to come.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You did say that you'd be sketching outside today.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Are you drawing flowers...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, for our next music video.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've tried drawing a bunch of different ones already, but I haven't been able to settle on one yet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. The song we're working on right now is about how the light that illuminates your way forward was by your side all along.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: One of those things you never notice until you look for it, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I was talking with Mizuki, and we decided we could express that as a lone flower blooming on a grassy plain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm really struggling to capture the song's gentle feeling.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I actually think your flowers feel really gentle, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But I want a flower that suits the song perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, I'm going to keep drawing until I manage one I'm happy with.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I know you will, Ena...!>
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still all wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This composition should draw the eye to the flower...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But it feels so artificial...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I can't express this naturalistically, I won't be able to do that song justice...)
Enaaa!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...?! What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just happened to pass by on my way home from work. I've actually been here for a while, but you didn't notice me at all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't want to disrupt your concentration, but the sun's starting to set.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? The sun...?
Wait, it's already dusk!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I did notice the shadows had changed, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So you didn't actually notice at all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. It is amazing how you can focus like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But if you push yourself too hard now, your work's going to suffer tonight, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Urgh... Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess I should call it a day for now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nice work, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, Mizuki, I'm really sorry...
That illustration's gonna take me a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm still not happy with what I've drawn.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I understand.
You have been toiling over it since yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We all heard you muttering “no, that's not right either!” and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, I wasn't muted?! Why didn't you tell me?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahaha. We figured we shouldn't bug you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Or you just wanted to laugh.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But really though, I'm not worried or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you always come up with the perfect illustrations for N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All I need to do is take that and turn it into the best music video I can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'm looking forward to this piece too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You can count on me.
I promise to draw the perfect piece for this song.
